fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: BANK CODE
fields.description: Bank clearing code of the reporting bank as issued by Kenya Banker's Association (KBA)

fields.name: BRANCH ID
fields.description: The branch where the application took place

fields.name: CUSTOMER ID
fields.description: Unique number for existing customers, otherwise left blank

fields.name: GENDER
fields.description: Customer's gender/sex with the possible options as {Male, Female, Corporate or Others}.

fields.name: LOAN APPLICATION ID
fields.description: Unique sequence number

fields.name: LOAN APPLICATION TYPE
fields.description: Whether the application is new or for modification of an existing contract

fields.name: LOAN PRODUCT TYPE
fields.description: The type of loan product applied for.

fields.name: REPORTING BUSINESS DATE
fields.description: Reporting Business Date. Format {DD-MMM- YYYY}

fields.name: DATE OF APPLICATION
fields.description: Date that the loan application was done. Format {DD-MMM-YYYY}

fields.name: LOAN APPLICATION STATUS
fields.description: Status of application - (approved/declined/pending/withdrawn)

fields.name: DATE OF APPROVAL/REJECTION DECISION
fields.description: Date when a decision was made to approve or reject a loan application. Format {DD-MMM- YYYY}

fields.name: CUSTOMER’S BUSINESS ECONOMIC SEGMENT
fields.description: The broad business economic segment in which the customer is in {Individual, retail, corporate, SME, MSME, etc.}

fields.name: ECONOMIC ACTIVITY CODE
fields.description: The Loan applied is in which economic activity as per ISIC guidelines

fields.name: CURRENCY OF APPLICATION
fields.description: ISO currency code in which the loan is applied.

fields.name: LOAN TENURE
fields.description: The loan repayment period for the facilityapplied.

fields.name: APPLIED LOAN AMOUNT IN FCY
fields.description: Loan applied amount in foreign currency

fields.name: APPLIED LOAN AMOUNT IN LCY EQUIVALENT
fields.payload_key: APPLIED LOAN AMT IN LCY EQUIV
fields.description: Loan applied amount in local currency equivalent

fields.name: LOAN APPROVED AMOUNT IN FCY
fields.description: Loan approved amount in foreign ccurrency

fields.name: LOAN APPROVED AMOUNT IN LCY EQUIVALENT
fields.payload_key: LOAN APPROVED AMT IN LCY EQUIV
fields.description: Loan approved amount in local currency equivalent

fields.name: DECLINE REASON
fields.description: Main reasons for rejection if the applicantion is rejected
